pattern: reduce H-stage BV tile to relieve shared-memory/register pressure
applies_when: NCU/NSYS shows high dynamic shared memory or low active blocks per SM on the H-state stage
resource_tradeoff: more V-grid programs and possible launch overhead
known_result: h-bv16 improved long single-sequence cases but did not meet the aggregate promotion gate

pattern: dispatch BV16/BV32 by measured average sequence length
applies_when: the same H tile has opposite behavior on long single-sequence and short/batched shapes
resource_tradeoff: extra dispatch branch and risk of a threshold overfit
required_evidence: full workload including short and batched cases
known_result: h-bv-dispatch improved long shapes but remained below the 1.03x full-workload gate

pattern: present a physically transposed H tile through a block view
applies_when: the profile attributes time to a materialized transpose or its surrounding layout conversion
resource_tradeoff: compiler layout constraints may add register/shared-memory traffic
required_evidence: five paired trials on the full workload
known_result: the candidate was correct but unstable and slower in aggregate

pattern: fuse H recurrence and O production for a restricted long-sequence path
applies_when: O work is not duplicated across the H grid and live values fit the target register budget
resource_tradeoff: live-value/register pressure and possible duplicate O work
known_result: the attempted fusion regressed long sequences because O work was duplicated and register pressure increased
